description: This PHP script is designed to run a scheduled job in the SuiteCRM environment. It initializes the environment, checks for CLI invocation, processes command-line arguments for job and client IDs, retrieves language settings, creates a system user, and executes a scheduled job via the SchedulersJob class. It also handles cleanup and database disconnection after execution.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Represents the system user in SuiteCRM, used here for obtaining the system user object.

classes.name: SchedulersJob
classes.description: Manages scheduled jobs in SuiteCRM, used to execute a specific job by ID.

classes.name: DBManagerFactory
classes.description: Provides database connection management, used here to disconnect from the database.

methods.name: runJobId
methods.description: Static method of SchedulersJob class to execute a job based on provided job ID and client ID.
